findings.title: A title that looks like an id shadows the real task's id
findings.why: `find` checks titles before ids. `add` accepts any valid title, so a task titled 'task-2' makes every id-based call (`complete`, `remove`, `rename`, `tag`) act on that task instead of task 2. Task 2 can then no longer be named by its id. Nothing prevents or reports the clash.

findings.title: Title length counts UTF-16 units, not characters
findings.why: The check uses `trimmed.length`, but the message and doc say 'characters'. Titles with emoji or other astral characters are rejected earlier than 120 characters and the reported length is overstated.
